problems: The front Elenchus lists only month groups (and the Supplementum), so each is one body-confirmed collection with 'parts' taken from the closing ORDO RERUM (96071-96380); parts are ordo-only, not body-confirmed.

Ordo OCR garbles several part columns, kept as read: Eustratii group (no col), Decem martyres Cretenses ('M" . 966'), Anastasia Junior ('1427'), Mercurii 269 vs Aecaterinae 215 (body running heads show Mercurii at 269, so Aecaterinae 215 may be misordered/garbled), Pelagia 901 (body 907), Ambrosius/other trailing pieces.
Elenchus month lines for Januarius (198), Februarius (gI), Aprilis (884) are garbled in OCR; body settles them at 793, 817, 831.
Nov head line 231 is the AKINAYNOY line of the title block printed in the Elenchus file; the first body page 9|10 carries no page-number lines in the OCR.
